scope: G4 RG16F fragment texture support exposed by the first original06 HDR draw. Full default-six and IQ gates remain pending.

nativeFirstFault.reason: NV40 texture format is not connected: 31
nativeFirstFault.drawMethod: Curie END1808; PGRAPH stops with source100/status4000, so zero renderer failures alone does not indicate a healthy run.

formatReference.definition: NV40_3D_TEX_FORMAT_FORMAT_RG16F=00001f00; PIPE_FORMAT_R16G16_FLOAT uses two half components and a crossbar with literalB0/A1.

change: Read four guest bytes per texel,retain paired half storage lanes through the component crossbar,and upload checked RGBA16F without converting through UNORM or Float32.
Reuse checked linear/Morton/cube/volume addressing,padded mip layouts and exact-byte cache; account eight uploaded host bytes per texel.
Apply the existing float gamma restriction and bypass TEX BX2 for RG16F,including constant remaps.

validation.before: New texture test fails on old source with unconnected format31.
validation.unit: Padded base/mip reads,distinct X/Y,negative zero,subnormal,HDR,Inf/NaN payload bits,crossbar zero/one/invalid selectors,and DMA range failure pass.
validation.realGPU: Complete native NV40 GPU regression passes,including half/full exports,paired/default and Nouveau remaps,BX2 bypass,bilinear interpolation with HDR/negative input,and minimum-LOD selection of a padded mip.
validation.other: Texture/render/state/graph/BC policy and175 WGSL shader modules pass; plugin Closure0errors/0warnings.

continuation.source: Healthy coherent100000-draw checkpoint from the same original default-six run,with screen saver/monitor power already disabled; matching OS/game overlays verified.
continuation.policy: Original driver/benchmark/guest RAM and interrupt state are not patched to skip the failure. Restart from the pre-fault checkpoint with the new emulator implementation.

limits: This establishes format support and reproduces the first fault; it is not a completed native HDR/default-six result.
